arXiv:2608.02454v1 [cs.AI] 2026 年 8 月 3 日arXiv:2608.02454v1 [cs.AI] 03 Aug 2026

使用有限跟踪技术的无限跟踪目标：将 LTL 转换为 LTLf+Infinite Trace Objectives with Finite Trace Techniques: Translating LTL to LTLf+

Christoph Weinhuber1\corresponding, Maximilian Prokop2,3, Giuseppe De Giacomo1, Moshe Y. Vardi4
摘要Abstract

线性时序逻辑（LTL）是用于指定人工智能中时间扩展目标的最广泛采用的语言之一，其应用范围从马尔可夫决策过程和强化学习中的反应合成到随机规划。传统上，解决任何这些问题都需要将 LTL 规范转换为无限字上的非确定性自动机，然后对其进行确定，这一步在理论上和实践中都非常困难。最近的工作引入了 LTLf+，它将有限迹线逻辑 LTLf 提升到无限迹线。 LTLf+ 具有与 LTL 相同的表达能力，但它保留了基本逻辑 LTLf 的大部分关键优势。 LTLf+ 中的大多数推理都依赖于有限词的有限自动机，为此我们不仅有规范的最小表示，而且有有效的确定过程。在这项工作中，我们提出了从 LTL 到 LTLf+ 的第一个翻译。我们首先将 LTL 公式标准化为 Manna-Pnueli 层次结构的句法反应性片段，以创建 LTLf+ 的一般基于片段的形状。然后，我们为该片段的每个单独组件提供线性翻译。经过这种转换，为 LTLf+ 开发的技术体系不断扩展，现在可用于解决当前在 LTL 中提出的许多人工智能问题。我们进一步表明，这没有渐近成本，因为通过 LTLf+ 从 LTL 到自动机的管道仍然是双指数的。Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) is one of the most widely adopted languages for specifying temporal extended objectives in AI, with applications ranging from reactive synthesis to stochastic planning in Markov decision processes and reinforcement learning. Traditionally, solving any of these problems requires translating the LTL specification to a nondeterministic automata on infinite words and then determinizing it, a step that is notoriously difficult in theory and in practice. Recent work has introduced LTLf+, which lifts the finite-trace logic LTLf to infinite traces. LTLf+ has the same expressive power as LTL, yet it retains most of the crucial advantages of its base logic LTLf. Most reasoning in LTLf+ rests on finite automata on finite words, for which we have not only a canonical minimal representation but also an efficient determinization procedure. In this work we present the first translation from LTL to LTLf+. We first normalize an LTL formula into the syntactic reactivity fragment of the Manna-Pnueli hierarchy, to create the general fragment-based shape of LTLf+. We then present linear translations for each individual component of that fragment. As a consequence of this translation, the expanding body of techniques developed for LTLf+ now becomes available to many AI problems currently formulated in LTL. We further show that this comes at no asymptotic cost, as the pipeline from LTL to automaton via LTLf+ remains doubly exponential.

1 简介Introduction

线性时态逻辑 (Linear Temporal Logic (零担运输LTL) (Pnueli 1977)是用于推理动态系统的时间行为的最广泛采用的规范语言之一。 它在模型检查中起着核心作用is one of the most widely adopted specification languages for reasoning about the temporal behavior of dynamic systems. It plays a central role in model checking(Baier and Katoen 2008), 反应合成, reactive synthesis(Pnueli and Rosner 1989), 监督控制, supervisory control(Ehlers et al. 2017)，以及针对临时扩展目标的人工智能规划, and AI planning for temporally extended goals(Bacchus and Kabanza 1998; De Giacomo and Rubin 2018; Camacho et al. 2019)。 在机器人技术中，. In robotics,零担运输LTL规范表达了复杂的任务目标，例如持续监视和对环境事件的有条件响应specifications express complex mission objectives such as persistent surveillance and conditional responses to environmental events(Fainekos et al. 2009)。 在业务流程管理中，. In business process management,零担运输LTL捕获合规性约束和程序要求captures compliance constraints and procedural requirements(Maggi et al. 2011)。 在所有这些领域中，. Across all these domains,零担运输LTL提供了一种自然的、声明性的方式来指定provides a natural and declarative way to specify什么what一个系统应该做的事情，而不需要规定a system should do, without prescribing如何how。 尽管其适用性广泛，但战略推理任务的计算成本，例如. Despite its wide applicability, the computational cost of strategic reasoning tasks, such as零担运输LTL合成，仍然是一个障碍。 传统的管道需要翻译synthesis, remains a barrier. The traditional pipeline requires translating an零担运输LTL将公式转化为无限字上的非确定性 Büchi 自动机并确定它。 但确定性步骤在理论上和实践上都是非常困难的formula into a nondeterministic Büchi automaton on infinite words and determinizing it. But the determinization step is notoriously difficult both in theory and in practice(Vardi 2007)，并且长期以来限制了可扩展性, and has long limited the scalability of零担运输LTL基于合成方法。-based synthesis methods.

为了避开确定性困难，最先进的To sidestep determinization difficulties, state-of-the-art零担运输LTL综合工具利用范式将公式分解为更简单公式的布尔组合synthesis tools exploit a normal form that decomposes the formula into a Boolean combination of simpler formulas(Esparza et al. 2024)。 每个组件都可以转化为确定性 Büchi 或 co-Büchi 自动机，并且它们的布尔组合直接产生确定性 Emerson-Lei 自动机. Each component can be translated into a deterministic Büchi or co-Büchi automaton, and their Boolean combination yields directly a deterministic Emerson-Lei automaton(Emerson and Lei 1987)，然后求解综合。 该范式基于 Manna 和 Pnueli 的安全进度层次结构, on which synthesis is then solved. This normal form is based on Manna and Pnueli’s safety-progress hierarchy(Manna and Pnueli 1990)，它区分了六类基本的时间属性：安全性（不会发生坏事）、保证（好事最终会发生）、它们的布尔组合（称为义务）、循环（好事发生无限频繁）、持久性（坏事只发生有限经常）以及它们的布尔组合（称为反应性）。 虽然标准化是最坏情况下的指数，但它现在被表现最好的使用, which distinguishes six basic classes of temporal properties: safety (nothing bad ever happens), guarantee (something good eventually happens), their boolean combinations, called obligations, recurrence (something good happens infinitely often), persistence (something bad happens only finitely often), and their boolean combinations, called reactivity. While the normalization is worst-case exponential, it is now used by the best-performing零担运输LTL综合工具，来自synthesis tools, from𝖲𝗍𝗋𝗂𝗑\mathsf{Strix} (Meyer et al. 2018) to 𝖲𝖾𝗆𝖬𝖫\mathsf{SemML} (Kretínský et al. 2025, 2026)，它们已经占据了主导地位, which have dominated the零担运输LTL近年来 SYNTCOMP 的合成轨迹。synthesis tracks of SYNTCOMP in the recent years.

最近，人工智能领域出现了一条不同的路线，围绕逻辑Recently a different route has emerged in AI, around the logicLTLF+LTLf+ (Aminof et al. 2025). LTLF+LTLf+建立在有限迹逻辑的基础上builds on the finite-trace logicLTFLTLf (De Giacomo and Vardi 2013, 2015)，它解释了语法, which interprets the syntax of零担运输LTL在有限的痕迹上。值得注意的是over finite traces. NotablyLTFLTLf公式可以有效地转化为确定性有限自动机（DFA）。 此外，与无限字对应物相比，DFA 可以有效地最小化。 结果formulas can be effectively translated into deterministic finite automata (DFAs). Furthermore, in contrast to their infinite-word counterparts, DFAs can be efficiently minimized. As a resultLTFLTLf综合正在达到模型检查的性能和可扩展性synthesis is reaching the performance and scalability of model checking(Duret-Lutz et al. 2025)，这又是一个工业现实, which in turn is an industrial reality(26; 27).

LTLF+LTLf+电梯liftsLTFLTLf再次通过吗哪-普努埃利等级制度，找到无限的痕迹。 它将四个前缀量词之一放在to infinite traces, again through the Manna-Pnueli hierarchy. It places one of four prefix quantifiers over anLTFLTLf公式，要求它保留一些前缀（formula, requiring it to hold on some prefix (∃\exists，保证），在每个前缀（, guarantee), on every prefix (∀\forall，安全），在无限多个前缀上（, safety), on infinitely many prefixes (∀∃\forall\exists，递归），或除有限多个前缀之外的所有前缀（, recurrence), or on all but finitely many prefixes (∃∀\exists\forall、坚持）。 这些量词与 Manna-Pnueli 层次结构的相应类别完全匹配，其布尔组合捕获了义务和反应性。, persistence). These quantifiers match exactly the corresponding classes of the Manna-Pnueli hierarchy, with obligations and reactivity captured by their Boolean combinations.LTLF+LTLf+具有充分的表达能力has the full expressive power of零担运输LTL，但它的推理问题主要是在基于有限迹构建的 DFA 上解决的, yet its reasoning problems are mostly solved on DFAs built from the finite-traceLTFLTLf子公式。subformulas.

因此我们缩小了差距We thereby close a gap in(Aminof et al. 2025)通过将存在的结果提升为建设性的结果。 此外，我们为新的合成管道铺平了道路，首先将by lifting the existential result to a constructive one. Further, we pave the way for a new synthesis pipeline, that first converts零担运输LTL to LTLF+LTLf+然后继续通过and then continues through theLTLF+LTLf+合成管道。 特别是，这允许基于 DFA 的技术（例如，自动机最小化，这在以前是禁止的）synthesis pipeline. In particular, this allows for DFA-based techniques (e.g. automaton minimization which previously was off limits for零担运输LTL）适用于中所述的问题) to be applied to problems stated in零担运输LTL。 更一般地，我们建立. More generally, we establishLTLF+LTLf+作为任意的实用中间语言as a practical intermediate language for arbitrary零担运输LTL规范，从而使为 LTLf 开发的基于 DFA 的技术不断发展的生态系统能够应用于超出有限范围规范的范围。 因此，我们能够为未来开发算法specifications, thereby enabling the growing ecosystem of DFA-based techniques developed for LTLf to be applied beyond finite-horizon specifications. We thereby enable future algorithms developed forLTLF+LTLf+充分发挥表达能力to be applied to the full expressive power of零担运输LTL无需额外的渐近成本。without additional asymptotic cost.

范式合成。Synthesis with Normal Form.

的TheΔ2\Delta_{2}范式是反应合成的标准起点normal form is the standard starting point for reactive synthesis from零担运输LTL (Meyer et al. 2018; Kretínský et al. 2025, 2026)。 为了构造一个确定性自动机，我们首先翻译各个组件（即. To construct a deterministic automaton, we first translate the individual components (i.e. theΣ2\Sigma_{2}定理中标准化的每个析取体和极限行为公式）bodies and the limit behavior formulae) for each disjunct of the normalization in Theorem4使用以下简单结构转化为确定性 Büchi 和 co-Büchi 自动机into deterministic Büchi and co-Büchi automata using the simple constructions fromEsparza et al. (2020)。这产生了确定性 Büchi 和 co-Büchi 的布尔组合，或者等效地，确定性 Emerson Lei 自动机，其中状态空间是同步乘积，并且接受条件是各个 Büchi 和 co Büchi 接受的完全相同的布尔组合。由于确定性 Büchi 和 co-Büchi 自动机的数量呈指数级增长，并且每个自动机的原始公式大小都是双指数的，因此 Emerson Lei 自动机有. This yields a boolean combination of deterministic Büchi and co-Büchi, or equivalently, a deterministic Emerson Lei automaton, where the state space is the synchronous product and the acceptance condition is the exact same boolean combination of the individual Büchi and co Büchi acceptances. As there are exponentially many deterministic Büchi and co-Büchi automata and each of them is doubly exponential in the original formulas size, the Emerson Lei automaton has(22O​(|φ|))2O​(|φ|)=22O​(|φ|)\big(2^{2^{O(|\varphi|)}}\big)^{2^{O(|\varphi|)}}=2^{2^{O(|\varphi|)}}州。直观上，指数级的许多因子在内指数内累积，而不是添加进一步的指数。这意味着，即使归一化产生指数大的公式，将该公式转换为确定性自动机也不会变成三指数。相反，标准化使我们能够获得理论上最优且实际上易于处理的 LTL 到确定性自动机的转换，为最先进的综合工具 Strix 提供动力states. Intuitively, the exponentially many factors are accumulating inside the inner exponent rather than adding a further exponentiation. This means that, even though the normalization yields an exponentially large formula, converting that formula to a deterministic automaton does not become triply exponential. Instead, the normalization allows us to obtain a theoretically optimal and practically tractable LTL-to-deterministic-automaton translation that powers the state of the art synthesis tools Strix(Meyer et al. 2018)和语义MLand SemML(Kretínský et al. 2025, 2026).

4 翻译Translating零担运输LTL to LTLF+LTLf+

四个前缀量词The four prefix quantifiers ofLTLF+LTLf+与安全进度层次结构的类别完全对应correspond exactly to the classes of the safety-progress hierarchy ofManna and Pnueli (1990)。 存在量词. The existential quantifier∃\exists表示担保性质（expresses guarantee properties (Σ1\Sigma_{1}）。 全称量词). The universal quantifier∀\forall表示安全属性（expresses safety properties (Π1\Pi_{1}）。 此外，交替量词). Further, the alternating quantifiers∀∃\forall\exists表达递归性质（express recurrence properties (Π2\Pi_{2}) 和对称组合) and the symmetric combination∃∀\exists\forall表达持久性属性（expresses persistence properties (Σ2\Sigma_{2}) (Aminof et al. 2025)。 因此，根据设计，每个. Thus, by design, everyLTLF+LTLf+公式是这 4 个片段的公式的布尔组合。formula is a boolean combination of formulae of these 4 fragments.

因此，当从任意 LTL 公式转换为 LTLf+ 时，我们首先使用定理的归一化Consequently, when translating from arbitrary LTL formulas to LTLf+, we first use the normalization of Theorem4创建 4 个片段的布尔组合的一般形状。 回想一下，这会产生三种类型公式的布尔组合，即：to create the general shape of a boolean combination of the 4 fragments. 8 结论Conclusion

在本文中我们表明In this paper we showed that零担运输LTL公式一旦采用正规形式，就可以转化为formulas, once in normal form, can be translated intoLTLF+LTLf+在线性时间内。 给定一个in linear time. Given an零担运输LTL公式formulaφ\varphi，其正常形式是大小的最坏情况, its normal form is worst-case of size2O​(|φ|)2^{O(|\varphi|)}。 然而，这种指数爆炸并没有反映出将 LTL 转换为确定性自动机的更高复杂性，这在 2EXPTIME 中仍然是最坏的情况（问题是 2EXPTIME 完成的）。 事实上，处理单个组件的简单性使其成为解决问题的最佳选择. This exponential blow-up, however, does not reflect in a higher complexity of translating LTL to deterministic automata, which remains worst-case in 2EXPTIME (the problem is 2EXPTIME-complete). In fact, the simplicity of handling the single components makes it the best option for solving零担运输LTL合成并被最先进的合成工具广泛采用synthesis and is largely adopted by the state-of-the art synthesis tools(Kretínský et al. 2025, 2026; Meyer et al. 2018)。 我们的翻译使基于 DFA 的技术开发用于. Our translation makes the DFA-based technology developed forLTFLTLf可供available to零担运输LTL合成。 特别是，所有中间 DFA 都可以最小化，这可以大大加快实践中的合成速度。 此外，除了综合之外，我们的翻译还影响到所有需要的领域synthesis. In particular, all intermediate DFAs can be minimized, which can drastically speed up synthesis in practice. Furthermore, beyond synthesis, our translation affects all areas which require零担运输LTL被翻译为确定性（或限制确定性） 自动机。 这包括马尔可夫决策过程to be translated to deterministic (or limit deterministic) automata. This includes Markov decision processes(De Giacomo et al. 2025), 随机规划, stochastic planning(Weinhuber et al. 2026)，和强化学习, and reinforcement learning(Hahn et al. 2020; Jackermeier and Abate 2025; Abate et al. 2026)。 因此，我们将 LTLf+ 建立为一种实用的中间语言，适用于各种上下文中的任意 LTL 规范。. We thereby establish LTLf+ as a practical intermediate language for arbitrary LTL specifications in a variety of contexts.

我们将这条路线的实际实现留给未来的工作。 作为第一步，我们已经在We leave the practical realization of this route to future work. As a first step, we have already implemented the full translation on top of the𝖲𝖯𝖮𝖳\mathsf{SPOT}图书馆library(Duret-Lutz et al. 2022)。 该实现超出了简单的构造，并且包括多项优化。 特别是对于广泛使用的义务片段. The implementation goes beyond the plain construction and includes several optimizations. In particular, for the widely used obligation fragment(Duret-Lutz et al. 2026)它会跳过 规范化以及严格完成和直接回报义务公式 的it skips both the normalization and the tight completion and directly returns obligation formulas ofLTLF+LTLf+.

Together with the unified零担运输LTL-到--to-ω\omega- 自动翻译-automata translation ofEsparza et al. (2020)，它重新燃起了人们对层次结构的兴趣, it has renewed interest in the hierarchy(Aminof et al. 2025).

零担运输LTL到确定性自动机。to deterministic automata.

翻译Translating零担运输LTL确定性的to deterministicω\omega-自动机是双指数的，而且是紧的-automata is doubly exponential, and this is tight(Kupferman and Rosenberg 2010)。 此外，通过 Büchi 自动机和 Safra 式确定的经典路线是出了名的困难. Moreover, the classical route through Büchi automata and Safra-style determinisation is notoriously difficult(Vardi 2007)。 确定性艾默生-雷自动机. Deterministic Emerson-Lei automata(Emerson and Lei 1987)携带穆勒接受条件，该条件以布尔公式的形式表示，这使得将复杂性从状态空间转移到接受条件成为可能。 特别是，carry a Muller acceptance condition that is expressed symbolically as a Boolean formula, which makes it possible to shift complexity from the state space to the acceptance condition. In particular,Müller and Sickert (2017)翻译（共同）安全和公平片段translate the (co-)safety and fairness fragments of零担运输LTL直接将这些片段之外的子公式委托给外部翻译器，并通过乘积组合各个部分。directly, delegate subformulas outside these fragments to external translators, and compose the parts by a product.

有限迹逻辑和Finite-trace logics andLTLF+LTLf+.

LTFLTLf解释有限轨迹上的时间规范，其中自动机对应物是 DFAinterprets temporal specifications over finite traces, where the automaton counterpart is the DFA(De Giacomo and Vardi 2013, 2015)，并支持一系列可扩展的综合工具, and supports a family of scalable synthesis tools(Zhu et al. 2017; Bansal et al. 2020; De Giacomo and Favorito 2021; Duret-Lutz et al. 2025)。 其纯过去变体 PPLTL 向后追踪并允许单指数大小的 DFA. Its pure-past variant PPLTL sees the trace backwards and admits DFAs of single-exponential size(De Giacomo et al. 2020). LTLF+LTLf+PPLTL+ 通过前缀量化将这种机制提升到无限踪迹and PPLTL+ lift this machinery to infinite traces through prefix quantification(Aminof et al. 2025)，通过 Emerson-Lei 博弈和 Manna-Pnueli 博弈综合, with synthesis through Emerson-Lei games and Manna-Pnueli games(Hausmann et al. 2025)，义务片段的符号算法, symbolic algorithms for the obligation fragment(De Giacomo et al. 2026), 和, andLTLF+LTLf+MDP 中的目标objectives in MDPs(De Giacomo et al. 2025; Weinhuber et al. 2026). Aminof et al. (2025)证明prove thatLTLF+LTLf+捕获所有captures all of零担运输LTL但不提供翻译。 我们的翻译提供了缺失的步骤，并将标准化与前缀量词连接起来。 我们的严格完成建立在安全和共同安全的经典前缀特征之上but do not provide a translation. Our translation supplies the missing step and connects the normalization with the prefix quantifiers. Our tight completion builds on classical prefix characterizations of safety and co-safety(Kupferman and Vardi 2001; Cimatti et al. 2023).

完整管道的参考实现，构建在A reference implementation of the full pipeline, built on top of the𝖲𝖯𝖮𝖳\mathsf{SPOT}图书馆library(Duret-Lutz et al. 2022)，可在线获取。, is available online.222https://github.com/weinhuber/ltl2ltlfplus它涵盖了规范化、最小紧补和翻译It covers the normalization, the minimal tight completion, and the translation ofΣ2\Sigma_{2}公式。 该实现超出了简单的构造，包括几个 优化。 特别是对于广泛使用的义务 片段formulas. The implementation goes beyond the plain construction and includes several optimizations. In particular, for the widely used obligation fragment(Duret-Lutz et al. 2026)它会跳过 规范化和严格完成并直接返回义务公式it skips both the normalization and the tight completion and directly returns obligation formulas ofLTLF+LTLf+.
